topic.title: Writing a Simple Program
topic.description: Creating basic Java programs step by step

sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Let’s build your first Java program together! You’ll learn how to turn a simple idea into working code.

• How to structure a basic Java program
• How to store and use data with variables
• How to make your program interactive

sections.title: Core Concepts
Code Examples
Key Points
points: Writing a program starts with defining the problem and identifying inputs/outputs
Declare variables first, then perform calculations, then display results
System.out.println() can concatenate strings and variables with the + operator
Use descriptive variable names to make the program self-documenting
Test programs with different input values to verify correctness

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Java programs start with a class and main method. Variables store data like containers store ingredients. Always test your program with different inputs. You’re ready to make interactive programs next.
